{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values in customer_age
missing_age = sales_df['customer_age'].isnull().sum()

# Check the data type of customer_age
dtype_age = sales_df['customer_age'].dtype

# Check for any sentinel values or implausible values (e.g., negative ages)
outliers = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_age'] < 0) | (sales_df['customer_age'] > 120)]

missing_age, dtype_age, outliers.shape[0]"}
